parsed.explanation: Same-sex conduct has been legal since 2007, there is no trans-specific criminal offence, and third-gender recognition exists. There is no documented state targeting, border friction, facility exclusion or custody-by-birth-sex practice affecting visitors. Most of the dossier (marker-change procedures, marriage registration, healthcare gaps, school dropout) concerns residents and counts only as climate signals. Traveller-relevant negatives are documented discrimination and physical or sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities (Nov 2024), rising anti-LGBTQ rhetoric, and threats by the new leader's supporters (Apr 2026). That is social hostility with some institutional discrimination, but not organised state targeting. Violence data lack a denominator, so the violence axis is undocumented. I score it in the upper Reduced Risk band, held down by the harassment and political hostility.
